title: The Four Seasons Poem 🍂 A Rhyme for Kids
description:
Spring, summer, autumn and winter! Mia shares an original rhyme about the four seasons and why they change, in under a minute.

Curio Kids Club: short, curious answers to kids' big questions. Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/@CurioKidsClub

lines.text: Do you know all four seasons?
There are four, and they go round and round each year. Let's rhyme them!
Spring brings buds to the trees, and flowers that wave to the bees.
Spring brings buds to the trees,
And flowers that wave to the bees.
Baby birds sing in nests up high. Rainbows smile across the sky.
Baby birds sing in nests up high,
Rainbows smile across the sky.
Summer is sunny, days are long. We splash and sing a happy song.
Summer is sunny, days are long,
We splash and sing a happy song.
Sandcastles rise along the shore. Run and jump and play some more!
Sandcastles rise along the shore,
Run and jump and play some more!
Autumn leaves turn gold and red. They twirl down to a crunchy bed.
Autumn leaves turn gold and red,
They twirl down to a crunchy bed.
Squirrels hide acorns away, for a chilly winter day.
Squirrels hide acorns away,
For a chilly winter day.
Winter brings frost and snow, so wrap up warm wherever you go!
Winter brings frost and snow,
So wrap up warm wherever you go!
Build a snowman, round and white, then cuddle up on a cosy night.
Build a snowman, round and white,
Then cuddle up on a cosy night.
Why do seasons change? Earth is tilted, so as it travels around the Sun, your part of Earth gets more sunlight, then less.
Spring, summer, autumn, winter too. Round and round, the year through!
Spring, summer, autumn, winter too
Round and round, the year through!
Which season is your favourite? Follow Curio Kids Club for more wonders. And next time someone asks... do you know all four seasons?
